title: One-Two Punch
description: Your next Attack is played an extra time this turn.
smart_description: Your next {Amount:plural:Attack is|[blue]{Amount}[/blue] Attacks are} played an extra time this turn.
notes: Counter-type power that decrements by 1 each time an Attack card is played. Displays 'Your next Attack is played an extra time this turn.' when stack is 1, and shows the count when stack is 2+. Automatically removed at the end of the player's turn.
